Plan 2 S15 — source-level public-domain rights evidence v1
Scope: THREE original English-language literary texts, NOT a corpus release.
Works:
- Jane Austen, Pride and Prejudice (1813); author died 1817.
- Lewis Carroll, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (1865); author died 1898.
- Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley, Frankenstein (1818); author died 1851.
Upstream: GITenberg public-domain repositories and Git-blob-pinned versions as recorded
in configs/data/plan2_public_domain_books_v1.json.
US original-work status: see each GITenberg README, marked Public Domain.
EU/Slovakia original-author term: EU Directive 2006/116/EC Art.1, author's
lifetime plus 70 years: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32006L0116
Transport/trademark terms: https://www.gutenberg.org/policy/license
The GITenberg/Project Gutenberg license notices, trademark statements,
volunteer production credits and generated headers/footers are NOT included
in the normalized source text. Historical author original texts alone are
the admitted candidate source objects. Any third-party additions, different
jurisdiction, new edition or changed upstream revision require requalification.
Public-domain rights apply to the ORIGINAL works only; these checks DO NOT
grant corpus/privacy/evaluation admission, tokenizer fitting, production release,
paid compute, model training, or final-test access.
The three books are different DOCUMENT families but all count as ONE upstream
source family en.project-gutenberg.public-domain-books, per
configs/data/next100_107_gutenberg_terminal_seal_v1.json.
